syntax: SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY day RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
summary: Aggregate by distance in an ordering value rather than a number of records.
documentation: For numeric ascending day values, a RANGE frame from 2 PRECEDING through CURRENT ROW includes records with day between current day minus two and current day, inclusive. All records sharing a day are peers and receive the same frame total within their device.
inputs: readings(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, device TEXT NOT NULL, day INTEGER NOT NULL, units INTEGER).
returns: id, device, day and recent_total, ordered by device, day, id.
caution: An offset RANGE frame requires one ORDER BY term. Adding id inside the window changes or invalidates this frame; put id only in the final output order. SUM ignores NULL and gives NULL for an all-NULL frame.
scenarios: Total readings over the latest three numbered days despite missing days.
Include every same-day transaction in a rolling report total.
Compare recent activity separately for each device or branch.
title: Sum a numeric day range
problem: Return id, device, day and SUM(units) AS recent_total over each device’s rows with day in [current day - 2, current day]. Include all same-day peers. Order output by device, day, id and preserve SUM’s NULL behavior.
hint: Use a RANGE frame ordered only by day; keep the id tie-breaker in the outer ORDER BY.
goal: Use RANGE window frame or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
